title: 3. Active Reconnaissance — Nmap
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L12: Recon, Scanning & Network Attacks: 3. Active Reconnaissance — Nmap.

blocks.text: Active = traffic touches target = logs and IDS alerts. Requires authorization.

rows: TCP SYN scan ("half-open"); fast, default for root
UDP scan; slow but finds DNS/SNMP/TFTP
Timing template (T4 normal, T0 paranoid for IDS evasion)

blocks.text: # Stage 2 — fast scan, top ports + version + default scripts nmap -sV -sC --top-ports 1000 -oA scan1 192.168.1.10
# Stage 3 — full port scan nmap -p- -sV 192.168.1.10 -oA scan_full
📋 Capture: in tmux, run the Stage 2 command on a CTF target like scanme.nmap.org and screenshot the resulting service table for the slide.
